title: RAG corpus list
description: The repos a RAG provider ingests. The provider follows each entry's branch head and every chunk names the commit it came from; nothing is pinned (mcl-rag#24). Ids must also be unique in the list, which JSON Schema cannot state; mcl-rag refuses a duplicate (duplicate_id).

id.description: Names the checkout directory and the ingest namespace (<id>/<path>). Renaming an entry re-ingests it.

url.description: An https clone url, or an absolute path to a git repo on the provider's own box. No credentials are ever used.

branch.description: The branch whose head is followed.
